name: l1000_imputation_fidelity
claim: CORRECTED (job 31676844, supersedes job 31661570): with the aggregate-vs-per-item p-value bug fixed, landmark genes clear their mismatched-pair null (mean rho 0.041, p=0.0005) and bing genes do too (p=0.0035); the remaining fully-imputed 'other' genes do not (p=0.1219, mean rho ~0). Cross-platform L1000/Tahoe delta agreement on directly-measured and best-inferred genes is real but weak (7% of the L1000 split-half ceiling of 0.572), not 'not established' as the superseded job concluded under the defective statistic.
